name: Spike (point)
description: Flags a sudden jump between consecutive samples as a point event (the same built-in the GUI 'Save rule' would produce).

rule.code:
-- A point event at a sudden jump between consecutive samples.
local s = series("--SOURCE--")
local JUMP = 0.8
for i = 1, s:size() - 1 do
  local a = s:at(i - 1)
  local b = s:at(i)
  if math.abs(b.v - a.v) > JUMP then
    createEvent(b.t, b.v, {label="spike", severity="error"})
  end
end
